source: CRON 2026-10-14: Kenya Airways PLC summary unaudited group results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 as filed (total income KES 81,254m, total operating costs KES 91,895m, operating loss KES 10,641m), with the pre tax loss of KES 15.92bn and the loss after tax of KES 16.075bn from the same announcement as carried by Reuters and People Daily. The filed statement is in KES millions and is stored here in KES. Income tax KES 155m is profit before tax less loss after tax, stated as an expense. EPS is left empty because no share count in the announcement reconciles with the EPS basis already held in this file.
source_note: FY2025 column transcribed from the summary audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2025 (KShs M in the source, stored here in KES). Every subtotal ties: total income 161,473 less total operating costs 167,080 = operating loss 5,607; operating loss less finance costs 12,399 plus interest income 79 = loss before tax 17,927; plus income tax credit 764 = loss for the year 17,163; basic loss per share 2.94. Net Profit is profit or loss for the year. The FY2024 comparative is reprinted from the same audited summary on the same basis: profit for the year 5,432 (the previously stored 19,812 was total comprehensive income for FY2024, a different line) and total operating costs 171,874 with the resulting operating profit 16,621. Cost of Sales is mapped from the airline's total operating costs, the first expense block below revenue; the split between direct, fleet ownership and other operating costs is not in the summary, so those rows are empty for FY2025. FY2023 and FY2022 remain on the source's total comprehensive income basis and were not re-derived.
